title: agent-health/1 (DEC-0179): one reading of what is wrong with a product or agent now, as counts and codes
description: What a product or agent answers about its own health at one instant: the worst state of its checks and, for each check, its area, its state, a count and the fix that clears it. Counts, kinds and codes only (DEC-0157): no account label, path, session id, host name or free text, so every object is closed. FAC-SEM-181: the report's state is the worst of its checks in the order ok < unknown < warn < fail, and unknown when it has none; each check id once; no name shaped like a credential or holding a home folder. A reader counts a report that fails this schema or FAC-SEM-181 as unknown, never ok (HL-5). docs/specification/agent-health.md.

product.description: The product or agent the reading is about, by its product id (DEC-0016): a lower-case letter, then letters, digits and hyphens, 2 to 63 characters.

version.description: The version of the product that took the reading.

at.description: When the reading was taken: whole seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z (Unix time), at most 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z.

state.description: The worst state of checks in the order ok < unknown < warn < fail, unknown when checks is empty (FAC-SEM-181, HL-2).

checks.description: Every check the product ran for this reading, each id once (FAC-SEM-181).

state.description: ok: measured and well; warn: works, needs attention; fail: broken now; unknown: not measured, never read as ok (HL-2).

id.description: The check's stable name in snake_case, at most 64 characters; a watcher keys an episode by product and id (HL-6), so it never changes between readings or versions.

area.description: What the check is about, from a closed list (HL-3): a new area is a new revision of this schema.

count.description: How many things the check found in its state (stuck sessions, leaked keys, errors today); 0 when it counts nothing.

fix.description: What clears the check (HL-4): absent or null for none, or exactly one of tool (an MCP tool of the product to call) and capability (a board capability of the owning project to ask). A step only a person can do (a sign-in, a payment) is named by a tool that answers human-step-required.

tool.description: An MCP tool name (1 to 128 of ASCII letters, digits, '_', '-' and '.').
